text:
Maria Chen: proposing a lightweight preflight + routing guardrails feature for the embeddings route. goal: catch dim/payload issues early, give the console actionable suggestions, and let routing/quotas make smarter decisions without full request execution.

Jay Patel: +1. curious how this differs from the current preflight shape checks we have in the router.

Maria Chen: current checks are binary (accept/reject) and live in the gateway; they don't return actionable hints. proposal: add /v1/embeddings/preflight that returns a small JSON describing: batchable:true/false, estimated_bytes, detected_dims, dim_confidence, suggested_split_strategy (none | split_by_vector | sparse-approx), and quota_risk (ok | soft_quota_hit | hard_quota_hit). console can surface these as warnings and automated suggestions.

Sasha Ivanov: can we avoid another blocking RPC on the hot path? preflight will be an extra network call in many flows.

Maria Chen: two flow options: 1) client calls preflight explicitly (SDKs and the console preflight button), 2) gateway does an optional async preflight for routes that enable 'preflight_on_send=true' with a small timeout (50ms) and falls back to normal execution if preflight doesn't respond. preflight responses are cached for short TTL keyed by shape/hash.

Evan Liu: we need telemetry fields. propose counters: preflight.total, preflight.dim_mismatch, preflight.split_suggestion_accepted, preflight.cache_hit. histogram: preflight.latency_ms. logs: sample payloads (sanitized) for >10% mismatch.

Leo Park: UX note: console should show per-route "preflight health" with percent of requests that required splitting, avg overhead_estimate, and a toggle to enable automated splitting at the gateway. For enterprise, also surface a "suggested quantization" recommendation if payloads are consistent and pushing cost.

Jay Patel: what about quota semantics? we already have soft quotas at org level that return 402-like warnings in the SDK. For embeddings, splitting can change unit accounting. If preflight says suggested_split_strategy=split_by_vector, do we debit the split estimate immediately or only after the request completes?

Maria Chen: suggest soft quota flow: preflight returns quota_risk=soft_quota_hit and an estimated_extra_units number. If customer accepts split, gateway reserves (not charges) the estimated units for a short window (30s) and marks route with reserved capacity. Real charge happens on completion. Reserve events are visible in console as "preflight reservations".

Sasha Ivanov: reservation sounds risky for capacity. can we convert to a soft-deny that returns a structured response to client SDK so apps can retry with smaller chunks?

Maria Chen: yes, make reservation opt-in per route. default behavior will be: 1) preflight_hint returned, 2) SDKs can auto-apply local split helper (we ship in SDK), 3) gateway auto-split/offload only if route enables auto_split=true.

Evan Liu: telemetry and billing teams will want a reproducible estimator. propose we include in preflight response: estimator_version and estimator_params_hash so offline cost audits can replay.

Leo Park: rollout plan: start with console-only preflight (developers can click 'simulate' with sample inputs), then beta auto-split for 10% traffic per route, then ramp. console shows rollout % and a per-route changelog.

console-bot: deploy-check: preflight service has contract change. please add integration tests for: a) preflight cache correctness, b) estimator deterministic across quantization modes, c) reservation TTL expiry.

Jay Patel: implementation notes: keep preflight lightweight: no heavy model ops, only shape + header analysis + a tiny sample embed (single vector hash) for dimension detection. don't run full model forward.

Sasha Ivanov: edge-case: mixed-dimension payloads where some items are 1536 and some 2048. what's recommended UX?

Maria Chen: two options shown in console: 1) prompt the user to normalize (recommended), 2) auto-split into homogeneous batches and route separately (higher latency). show estimated cost/time tradeoffs. also add a per-route "mixed-dim strategy" default.

Evan Liu: logging detail: tag events with route_id, user_org, estimator_version, preflight_decision, and splitting_strategy. redaction: never store raw text embeddings or exact vectors in logs, only lengths and dim metadata.

Leo Park: can we extend the preflight to produce an embedding-safety score (e.g., if payload contains PII or banned tokens) so console can flag privacy-sensitive patterns before sending?

Maria Chen: we could add optional content_flagging boolean that runs a lightweight tokenizer + pattern checks. this will be off by default and only enabled for orgs that opt into content prechecks due to privacy.

Jay Patel: API sketch (example):
```
POST /v1/embeddings/preflight
Body: { "route_id": "r_abc", "items": [ { "id": "1", "bytes": 1200, "vector_dim_hint": 1536 }, ... ] }
Response: { "batchable": true, "detected_dims": [1536], "suggested_split_strategy": "none", "estimated_units": 42, "estimator_version": "v1.2.0" }
```

Sasha Ivanov: important: preflight should return a canonical canonicalized request that SDK can use to re-submit safely (e.g., with split metadata).

Maria Chen: agreed. we'll include a preflight_token that encodes suggestions; SDKs can attach preflight_token in follow-up request to opt into reservation/auto-split. token TTL short.

Evan Liu: one more: telemetry for failure modes: preflight.handoff_fallback_count for when gateway didn't wait and executed original request. we need instrumentation to correlate preflight hint vs actual execution path.

Leo Park: docs/console copy: show quick examples, a "what changed" banner, and a help link that explains quotas vs reservation. also add a small interactive widget that visualizes how splitting affects per-item latency and cost.

Maria Chen: next steps: I'll draft a spec PR with API contract + console mockups. @Jay @Sasha please review estimator edgecases. Evan, can you scope telemetry events? console-bot: file a ticket for integration tests.

console-bot: created issue PLT-EMB-PREFLIGHT-42 for integration tests and PLT-EMB-PREFLIGHT-43 for console mockups.

Jay Patel: on it. will kick off a quick PoC for the SDK split helper.

Sasha Ivanov: I'll review the estimator code paths and evaluate privacy implications.

Maria Chen: thanks all. I'll ping again when the PR is up. :thumbsup:
